thread:
Noah (Design): Quick thought: what if invoice rows default to a compact list with a left-aligned 24x48 sparkline, amount at right, and a chevron to expand details. Idea attached in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123 :sparkles:
Priya (PM): I like compact for scanning. Important: users need to quickly toggle Org vs Project scope and switch token denomination without diving into settings. Inline controls? :slider:
Jun (Frontend): Inline controls ok but careful with touch targets. 24px icons are borderline for mobile. Recommend 36px min for tappable area even if icon visually smaller.
Rina (Eng): Performance note: if we render thousands of invoice rows, even simple svgs add up. Suggest virtualization + lazy-render of expanded content. Also cap the number of visible sparklines to first 200 and render placeholders for rest.
Liam (Data): From analytics, 92% of invoices have <50 lines. For the long tail we should auto-switch to condensed view. We can detect count at server and include a flag in payload.
Noah (Design): Good call. For condensed mode copy: "Condensed invoice view for large statements — show full details" (button). Simple and actionable.
Priya (PM): UX decision: when scope=Org we aggregate lines by project by default or show a project filter? Which is less surprising?
Jun (Frontend): Aggregation helps reduce noise, but we should indicate aggregation state clearly: e.g., a badge "Aggregated by project" with a tooltip. Also add a small chevron to expand into per-project lines.
Rina (Eng): Accessibility: if aggregation opens a nested list, ensure aria-levels or role="tree" semantics so screen readers can navigate. Avoid trying to fake with only headings.
a11y-bot: Accessibility reminder: use role="button" with aria-expanded on chevrons, ensure focusable elements are 48x48 CSS and visible focus ring, and announce aggregation state e.g., "Showing 12 projects aggregated". Color contrast: sparkline strokes should be at least 3:1; active selection use 4.5:1.
Noah (Design): Copy for token toggle: small label "Tokens / USD" is terse. Alternative: use a segmented control with icons and aria-label: "Display units". Thoughts?
Priya (PM): Segmented control preferred. Track event invoice.units.toggle with new_unit in payload. Also track whether users flip often — might indicate confusion.
Liam (Data): Agree on event names. Suggest we also log invoice.view.mode (compact|full|condensed) and number_of_expanded_rows.
Jun (Frontend): Keyboard nav plan: Tab into list, arrow keys to move between rows, Enter/Space to toggle. For nested project expansion, treat arrow right as expand, left as collapse. Simple and consistent.
Rina (Eng): We'll reuse our list keyboard hook from /console. Need to ensure we don't break existing focus traps (modals). Also implement IntersectionObserver + requestIdleCallback for heavier histogram rendering.
Noah (Design): Microinteraction: animate the sparkline -> histogram morph on expand. Keep it subtle (120ms). If heavy, fade to histogram after expand completes.
Priya (PM): Accessibility caution: animations must respect reduced-motion setting. If prefers-reduced-motion, skip morph and just show new content.
a11y-bot: Add live-region announcement when expanded panel contains important billing changes, e.g., "This line has a new estimated USD value". Use aria-live="polite".
Liam (Data): One ask: include a tiny trend label next to sparkline: up/down arrow + percent change month-over-month. Users scan for anomalies with that. Keep percent secondary text.
Noah (Design): I can add that to Figma. We'll show percent in muted caption to the right of sparkline.
Jun (Frontend): Dev question: recommended threshold for condensed auto-switch? Liam said server flag; propose client fallback: if rows>200 and DOM nodes>500, enable condensed.
Rina (Eng): Sounds reasonable. We'll add feature flag to toggle server-driven vs client-driven behavior during rollout.
Priya (PM): Next steps: Noah to update Figma with compact + condensed variants, Jun to prototype keyboard/virtualized list, Rina to outline implementation plan and perf guardrails, Liam to prepare metrics. Sync tomorrow 10:30am PT?
Noah (Design): Yep, will post updated spec with a11y checklist. Tagging @a11y-bot for verification items. :white_check_mark:
